ideas.pitch: An automated portfolio construction and machine learning price forecasting suite tailored for the IIT Kanpur Techkriti Beat The Market challenge.
ideas.problem_statement: Online Round: Portfolio Building & Analysis and Offline Round: Machine Learning-Based Stock Price Prediction using virtual stocks.
ideas.title: AlphaESG Portfolio & Time-Series Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets both evaluation phases of the competition by combining fundamental portfolio weighting with robust time-series machine learning forecasting models.

ideas.pitch: A specialized machine learning toolkit designed to forecast stock prices from historical time-series data up to 2026 for the offline round.
ideas.problem_statement: Offline Round: Machine Learning-Based Stock Price Prediction for the selected stocks.
ideas.title: QuantStock ML: Multi-Horizon Price Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses purely on the offline machine learning round by implementing advanced time-series modeling to outperform other predictive models.

ideas.pitch: A natural language and quantitative dashboard that ingests financial statements and news to build an optimized 8-stock portfolio while justifying exclusions.
ideas.problem_statement: Online Round: Portfolio Building & Analysis with ESG factors and exclusion justification.
ideas.title: ESG-Metrics Portfolio Rationale Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific bonus challenge of justifying excluded stocks and incorporating ESG factors into the portfolio evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A systematic quantitative finance platform that evaluates technical indicators, fundamental statements, and backtests virtual fund allocation.
ideas.problem_statement: Online Round: Portfolio Building & Analysis and Offline Round: Machine Learning-Based Stock Price Prediction.
ideas.title: Systematic Equity Backtester and Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous benchmarking and systematic verification inspired by winning financial engineering strategies.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end web application for the Beat The Market challenge that handles portfolio selection, rationale reporting, and ML price forecasting in one interface.
ideas.problem_statement: Online Round: Portfolio Building & Analysis and Offline Round: Machine Learning-Based Stock Price Prediction.
ideas.title: Techkriti Market Oracle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an exceptionally polished, end-to-end user experience that makes fundamental rationales and machine learning predictions easy for judges to review.
